prerequisites: Basic notions of Physics and Mathematics.

learning_outcomes.text: Knowledge of the laws of thermodynamics, transport for heat, mass and fluid transfer
Use and manipulation of formulas and equations, easily managing their measurement units
Transfer and communications info on technological issues
Capacity of actively participating to seminars and full days of formation
Ability of self-widening their scientific-cultural knowledges, going on to update on scientific and technological developments more recently connected to engineering science
Ability of efficiently participating in the MSc degrees courses of the engineering field

syllabus_topics: FLUIDS: DEFINITIONS, STATICS, CYNEMATICS AND DYNAMICS
teaching_methods: Lectures with slide projection and professor explanation
bibliography: G. Lorenzini, “Lezioni di Fisica Tecnica”, Ed. UNINOVA, 2025.
